Negative Appraisals.value: I have permanently changed for the worse
The event happened because of the way I acted
I acted in ways that go against who I am

vignette: María, a 27-year-old Latina animator, has been struggling to find her footing since she escaped an abusive relationship. The physical abuse inflicted by her former romantic partner left deep emotional and psychological scars that have colored her perception of herself and the world around her. The traumatic event, which occurred two years ago, began with small instances of manipulation and escalated into severe physical violence. María was certain that she had permanently changed for the worse after each incident. The memory of being struck repeatedly while trying to defend herself is seared into her mind, a vivid reminder of how powerless and vulnerable she felt during those moments. Her self-blame has been particularly debilitating. María believed that if only she had acted differently or communicated better with her partner, he wouldn’t have turned violent. This belief has led her to second-guess every decision she makes now, constantly wondering what she could have done to prevent the abuse from happening. The guilt and shame she feels are overwhelming, making it difficult for her to trust anyone or form new relationships. Moreover, María felt as though she violated her own values during the relationship. She had always prided herself on being independent and strong-willed, but in the face of her abuser’s aggression, she often found herself compromising her principles just to survive another day. This internal conflict has left her questioning who she truly is and whether she will ever be able to regain her sense of self. The aftermath of the abuse has had a profound impact on María's daily life as an animator. She finds it challenging to focus on work tasks that require collaboration or interaction with others, as she constantly worries about being judged or criticized. This fear leads her to isolate herself from colleagues and friends, further exacerbating her feelings of loneliness and isolation. Despite the passage of time, María’s symptoms have only intensified, making it increasingly difficult for her to function normally. She recently realized that she cannot continue living in this state of chronic anxiety and self-doubt. What finally brought her to seek help was a recent project deadline at work, where her inability to concentrate led to significant errors and criticism from her supervisor. María is most afraid of never being able to fully recover or feel like herself again. She hopes that therapy can provide her with the tools she needs to break free from these negative thoughts and rebuild her sense of self-worth. Her primary goal is to regain confidence in her abilities and trust in others, so she can lead a fulfilling life once more. In her current state, María feels trapped by the belief that she has permanently changed for the worse and that any attempt to move forward will be met with failure or judgment. However, she remains hopeful that with support and guidance, she can navigate through these challenges and find healing.
